description: Read bet365 pregame prices: moneyline, spread, total and team total for NFL, NCAAF, NBA, NCAAB, NHL and MLS, and match result, double chance, goal line and goalscorer markets for EPL, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1 and the Champions League, in American, decimal and fractional odds.
